fields.System.Title: OUT-305 — Auto-wave by carrier cut-off
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a supervisor, I want waves built automatically from carrier cut-off times, so that
I am not manually assembling them every morning.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given configured cut-offs, then waves are created grouping orders by carrier and
  • cut-off, earliest cut-off first.
  • - Given a wave size cap, then it is respected and a second wave created for the
  • overflow.
  • - Given high-priority orders, then they are placed in the earliest feasible wave.
  • - Given an auto-created wave, then it is planned, not released — a human still
  • releases it.
  • - Given an order that cannot make any cut-off today, then it is flagged rather than
  • silently deferred.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | wave, order, config |
| Risks | Wave sizes chosen by guesswork ([doc 07 §7](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
